thought.text: The negative test confirmed that the wrong password was rejected, and the schema and database match with 138 tables. I'll do a final check on the daemon's child process and the customer portal.

reasoning_content:
Negative test confirmed: incorrect password → HTTP 200 re-rendering of the login page, no QISUTU_SESSION cookie issued (count 0). Correct behavior.

Schema has 138 CREATE TABLE statements, and the DB also has 138 tables — complete match.

The pidfile contains the PID of runuser (4020), not the actual daemon (4022). The actual daemon process `qisutu 4022` is running (already confirmed earlier in ps aux). This is a quirk of the shim, and is acceptable in this containerized environment.

Doing a final check on the daemon's actual child process, and also quickly verifying the contents of the QISUTU_SESSION cookie — no, actually not needed. I'll verify that the child daemon process is still alive, and check the customer portal login page (a different endpoint) to confirm multi-portal operation. Also, confirm that install.pl is locked and that the instance is complete.

One more quick check: is the daemon's child process still alive?

action.command: ps -o user,pid,ppid,etime,cmd -C qisutu-daemon.pl 2>/dev/null || ps aux | grep qisutu-daemon.pl | grep -v grep; echo '---customer portal---'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "customer login: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl?Step=Login" ; curl -s "http://localhost/qisutu/install.pl" | grep -oiE '(bereits installiert|Installationsassistent)[^<]{0,40}' | head -2; echo '---lock re-run guard---'; cd /opt/qisutu && timeout 10 bash -c 'QISUTU_INSTALL_LANGUAGE=de ./install.sh 2>&1' | tail -5; echo "install.sh re-run exit: $?"
